pages.title: Faraday Isolator
pages.text: A garnet crystal in a strong magnetic field turns the plane of polarised light - the same way whichever way the light goes. Light passes out; its reflection, turned twice, cannot pass back.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Crystallography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Laser Head.
